Un produit réussi répond à un besoin rée: A successful product meets a real need. The functional specification (CdCF) turns that need into measurable requirements; traceability need → requirement → test proves that what was asked for was delivered.
Un projet de produit est une suite de pa: A product project is a series of bets: you cannot design everything at once. The PDP splits the work into phases that close on a review; Lean Startup adds one MVP per phase to test the riskiest hypotheses first.
Un requirement ne quitte « Customer Clar: A requirement leaves “Customer Clarification” only when all its questions are closed.
Un requirement ne s'efface jamais (traça: A requirement is never erased (traceability, D-B-061). Fix: move it to status “Rejected” or “Obsolete”; it remains viewable with its history.
Un requirement sans essai est une promes: A requirement without a test is a promise. Verification proves that the product was built right (according to the requirements); validation, that the right product was built (for the customer). In Canada and the United States, a consumer electrical product must also pass safety (CSA, UL) and EMC (ICES-003, FCC Part 15).
Un requirement tiré d'une norme arrive «: A requirement taken from a standard arrives “To verify”: confirm the edition and the clause.

Un retour à l'utilisateur (son, lumière,: Feedback to the user (sound, light, movement) for each command

Un seul refus arrête tout : rien n'est a: A single refusal stops everything: nothing is applied, and the site writes a “Feedback for Claude” (button “Copy the feedback for Claude”). Paste it into the conversation: Claude fixes what was refused and keeps the rest; then check the new zip.

A ticket changes status only through a transition listed here.
